chunks: Ahmad b. Ziyad b. Ja'far al-Hamadani (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim, from Ali b. al-Hakam, from Hisham b. Salim, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon him). He said:

Nuh (peace be upon him) lived for two thousand five hundred years. From them, he lived eight hundred and fifty years before he was commissioned, and he called his people for nine hundred and fifty years, and he spent two hundred years building the Ark, and five hundred years after he descended from the Ark and the water dried up -- establishing regions and settling his descendants across the countries.

Then the Angel of Death came to him while he was in the sun, and said: Peace be upon you. Nuh replied and said to him: What has brought you here, O Angel of Death? He said: I have come to take your soul. He said to him: Will you allow me to move from the sun to the shade? He said: Yes. So Nuh (peace be upon him) moved from the sun to the shade. Then he said: O Angel of Death! My time in this world is like my movement from the sun to the shade; so proceed with what you were commanded to do. He said: So he took his soul (peace be upon him).

key_terms.السفينة: The Ark -- the vessel built by Prophet Nuh at Allah's command to survive the great flood
key_terms.ملك الموت: Angel of Death -- the angel tasked with taking souls at the time of death
key_terms.من الشمس إلى الظل: From the sun to the shade -- Nuh's metaphor for the brevity of worldly life

ai.seo_question: How did Prophet Nuh describe the brevity of worldly life to the Angel of Death?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describes the lifespan of Prophet Nuh (Noah), totaling 2,500 years divided across different periods of his mission. The climactic scene depicts the Angel of Death coming to Nuh while he was in the sun. Nuh asks to move to the shade, then reflects that his entire worldly life felt as brief as that single step from sunlight to shadow, encapsulating the transience of worldly existence.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Ziyad b. Ja`far al-Hamadani (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father Ibrahim b. Hashim from `Ali b. al-Hakam from Hisham b. Salim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:

Nuh (as) lived for two thousand five hundred years. From them, he lived eight hundred and fifty years before he was commissioned, and he called to his community for nine hundred and fifty years, and he lived seven hundred years after disembarking from the Ark – and the water dried from region to region – and his descendants settled in the countries.

Then, the Angel of Death came to him while he was in the sun, so he said to him: Peace be with you. So, Nuh replied. Then, he said: What has brought you here, O Angel of Death? So, he said: I have come to take your soul. He said: Will you allow me to move from the sun to the shade? So, he said: Yes. So, Nuh (as) moved from the sun to the shade. Then, he said: O Angel of Death! My time in this world is like my movement from the sun to the shade; now do what you were commanded to do. He said: So, he took his (as) soul.
